name: LOGHUB_SYSLOG
description: go-relplog-nats-server (and go-syslog-nats-server): JLH type=syslog of space default. Only the exact subject loghub.default.syslog (no facility-severity subjects); never loghub.> (it would capture the control plane, loghub._ctl.beacon). The same stream of go-syslog-server and go-relplog-server, whose stream.json adds loghub.default.syslog.> and covers this one too. SPEC 3.8, 10.7.
